auditType: Authentication Storage & Rate Limiter Persistence Verification

rateLimiter.persistentStore: SQLite table auth_rate_limits with UPSERT ON CONFLICT(key)
rateLimiter.productionConsiderations: Local SQLite engine is single-node. Multi-instance horizontal scaling across containers in Phase 2/3 will require centralized Redis.

sessionStorageAndRevocation.productionConsiderations: Requires PostgreSQL connection pool for multi-instance horizontal scaling.

conclusion: Empirical testing confirms rate limiting is HYBRID (in-memory Map cache backed by SQLite auth_rate_limits table). Lockouts survive process restarts. Session revocation is 100% database-persisted in auth_sessions.
